name: Ice Tiles
description: A grid of ice tiles laid back in perspective; each tile the pointer crosses lights up and slowly melts back.

props.name: rows
props.description: Rows of tiles in the plane.

props.name: cols
props.description: Columns of tiles in the plane.

props.name: cellSize
props.description: Tile edge in pixels, before perspective.

props.name: colors
props.description: Tints a crossed tile can take, up to eight. Each tile's tint is fixed by a seeded random pick.

props.name: fadeMs
props.description: How long a tile takes to melt back after the pointer leaves it, in milliseconds.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which is relative and clips the plane. Other div props are passed through.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered above the tiles with pointer-events: none, so the tiles still feel the pointer. Give interactive children pointer-events-auto.
